title: INSTA: An Ultra-Fast, Differentiable, Statistical Static Timing Analysis Engine for Industrial Physical Design Applications
problem: GPU-accelerated STA (static timing analysis) fails to gain adoption because it cannot emulate proprietary delay models of commercial tools; high-accuracy incremental timing for iterative design loops is slow.
motivation: Physical design optimization (gate sizing, placement) requires millions of timing queries; gradient-based optimization demands differentiable timing models.
method: GPU-STA initialized from reference commercial tool (one-time setup), then fine-tuned to model tool's delay characteristics. Differentiable engine enables gradient computation for timing optimization; demonstrated on gate sizing and placement tasks with 25x faster incremental updates.
key_novelty: Differentiable, calibrated GPU-STA that achieves 0.999 correlation with signoff tool, enabling gradient-based global timing optimization.
contributions: Calibration from commercial tool for high accuracy
INSTA-Size achieves 15% better TNS with 68% fewer gates
INSTA-Place improves HPWL 16% and TNS 59.4% on ICCAD benchmarks
limitations: Calibration requires reference tool; applicability to different technology nodes requires re-calibration.
